headline: Levante vs Athletic: a flat board and a sharp split
summary: Athletic Club are clear favourites at 43.7% fair against Levante's 25.5%, with the draw at 30.8%. The Asian handicap sits around Levante +0.25 and moved only 0.2-0.3 percentage points across four snapshots in eight hours. Over 2.5 is frozen at 49.1%, with a fair total of 2.47; both teams to score is slightly favoured at 53.3%. Four injury names — three Levante, one Athletic — produced no visible reaction after our first report at 00:55, though there is no earlier baseline. The notable feature is a pricing split: the sharp market's Home price is 9% above the six-book average, roughly 2.5 points of fair probability, but it is static rather than a move, and with no true opening price the cause can't be pinned down.
